title: What Is an API? A Beginner's Guide
author: Maya Rao
summary: A plain-language introduction to APIs, how apps talk to each other, and why developers rely on them every day.
image_alt: Illustration of two apps exchanging data through an API
body: An API (Application Programming Interface) is a set of rules that lets one piece of software ask another for data or actions.
Think of a restaurant: you (the app) tell the waiter (the API) what you want, and the kitchen (the server) prepares it.
Next, read {{how-websites-load}} to see where APIs fit into loading a web page.
